rules.description: Renewal scholarship applications that are duly verified may be considered for lot generation.
rules.condition: Renewal of scholarship does not require preparation of merit list or obtaining of beneficiary id and the application is duly verified.
rules.outcome: The application may be considered for lot generation.
rules.evidence_quote: As renewal of scholarship does not require preparation of merit list or obtaining of beneficiary id, therefore, duly verified applications may be considered for lot generation.

rules.description: After lot generation, scholarship approval and disbursal follow the same process as fresh applications.
rules.outcome: The process for scholarship approval and disbursal will be similar to that for fresh applications.
rules.evidence_quote: Subsequent to lot generation, the process for scholarship approval and disbursal will be similar to that for fresh applications.

rules.description: The entire scholarship process, including disbursal, must be completed by 31st October 2017.
rules.condition: There shall be two-stage verification cases.
rules.outcome: The process may be completed by 31st October, 2017.
rules.evidence_quote: The entire process including scholarship disbursal may be completed by 31st October, 2017 since there shall be two-stage verification cases.
